_note: Facts that became public after 30-Sep-2026. Not used in the initiation (as of 30-Sep-2026); kept for the Q2FY27 results update.

facts.fact: Q2FY27 consolidated results: revenue Rs4,741 cr (+49% YoY), EBITDA Rs140 cr (OPM ~3%), other income Rs179 cr, PAT Rs200 cr (-38% YoY); results and investor call in early November 2026.
facts.src: Screener quarterly table (fetched 16-Nov-2026); BSE announcements Nov-2026

facts.fact: Board approved the 600 MTPD phosphoric acid + 1,800 MTPD sulphuric acid project at Sikka (13-Oct-2026); project cost cited as ~Rs3,000 cr on the Q2FY27 call; EPC awarded to Tata Projects; production in roughly 30-33 months.
Sikka C-Train (APS/DAP swing) commissioned (reported on the Q2FY27 call).
Cabinet approved Rabi 2026-27 NBS rates on 11-Nov-2026: outlay Rs62,370 cr (Rs24,418 cr above rabi 2025-26), DAP price unchanged.
Board approved renouncing rights and transferring 6.5 lakh shares of Gujarat Port & Logistics Co. (GPLCL); GPLCL ceases to be a subsidiary.
Sep-2026 shareholding: Quant Small Cap 2.34% (3.43% in Jun-2026), ICICI Pru Small Cap 1.36% (1.67%); FIIs 12.51%.
